topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I shouldn't be bothered by this, really. It's just a fence. But when they came by, all smiles and neighborly warmth, I found myself hesitating. They want to put it up right at the property line, which should be fine, I suppose. It's their right, isn’t it? Yet, it feels like a change, a step towards closing off, a bit of the warmth going out of the neighborhood. I nodded, trying to keep my voice steady, and mumbled my approval. They were pleased, of course, and I nodded again, hoping it didn’t look forced. Maybe it’s just the start of something different, and I can’t help but wonder if this is how it begins, a little at a time.
